questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Due to tight deadlines for delivery and increased focus on performance outcomes, many employees are unable to enjoy a proper work life.

B. Stress could emanate out of various situations such as lifestyle, health or relationship issues, lack of support system at home and competitive focus on acquiring material symbols of success and career advancement.

C. In today's fast-moving world, many young professionals are vulnerable to stress.

D. To add to this, the current economy has impacted many companies' revenues and profits which, in effect, have put many jobs at risk resulting in the frequency of counselling support and guidance going up significantly.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**CBAD.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given question,
 
 
• Sentence C introduces the topic of stress among young professionals in today's fast-moving world.
 
• Sentence B explains the various sources of stress, including lifestyle, health, relationships, lack of support, and competitive focus on success and career advancement.
 
• Sentence A specifically mentions the impact of work-related stress due to tight deadlines and performance pressure.
 
• Sentence D provides additional context by highlighting the economic impact on companies and the resulting increase in demand for counselling support and guidance.
 
 
 
• Thus, from the above explanation, the correct order will be "CBAD."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

questions.question: Identify how you will you ask everyone if the sweets will be delivered by jack today in active voice.

options.text: Jack will deliver the sweets today.
Will Jack be delivering the sweets today?
Will Jack deliver the sweets today?
Are the sweets to be delivered by Jack today?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Will Jack deliver the sweets today?**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We are required to ask the required information in active voice in for of an interrogation.
 
• Now, **among the given options, the correct option is option 3**.
 
 
• The sentence is in the active voice because the subject (Jack) is performing the action (delivering the sweets).
 
• The sentence is a question because it starts with the auxiliary verb "will" and ends with a question mark.
 
• The sentence is in the present tense because it refers to an action that will happen today.
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct because it follows the subject-verb-object word order.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the given information in a question and in active voice is in option 3.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Jack will deliver the sweets today," is also in the active voice and present tense, but it is a statement rather than a question.
 
• Option 2, "Will Jack be delivering the sweets today?" is also a question, but it uses the future continuous tense, which implies that the action will be ongoing or in progress at a specific time in the future.
 
• Option 4, "Are the sweets to be delivered by Jack today?" is a question in the passive voice, which means that the subject receives the action rather than performing it. It is also worded awkwardly and unnecessarily formal.
